Definition
[Ideal simplex] \group ideal-simplex-volume Source: thurston:page-0174

An ideal simplex $\Sigma _{\alpha ,\beta ,\gamma }$ is a hyperbolic tetrahedron whose vertices lie at infinity. Its opposite dihedral angles agree, and the three angles satisfy $\alpha +\beta +\gamma =\pi $.
